description: Four Karplus-Strong resonators fed from one input, each tuned to its own pitch, with a shared decay, tone and mix and the four voices out separately as well as summed

params.text: Tunes its resonator, -54 to 54 semitones from C4 at 261.63Hz
Sets the level of its resonator's contribution, 0 to 1, the hover text reading it in decibels
Sets how long the resonators ring, 0 to 1; the setting is raised to the power of 0.2 and mapped onto a feedback of 0.7 to 0.995, so most of the useful travel is near the bottom
Sets the tone of all four resonators at once: counter-clockwise of the centre brings a lowpass down from 20kHz to 200Hz, clockwise takes a highpass up from 20Hz to 2000Hz
Scales the sum of the four resonators before it reaches the OUT jack, 0 to 1; the WET jack is not touched by it
Crossfades the OUT jack between the untouched input at fully counter-clockwise and the resonated sum at fully clockwise
Attenuates and inverts the DECAY jack, -1 to 1, before that voltage is added to the DECAY knob
Attenuates and inverts the COLOR jack, -1 to 1, before that voltage is added to the COLOR knob
Attenuates and inverts the GAIN jack, -1 to 1, before that voltage is added to each GAIN knob
Attenuates and inverts the MIX jack, -1 to 1, before that voltage is added to the MIX knob

inputs.text: The audio the four resonators are excited with
One volt per octave added to the first resonator's FREQ knob; with more than one channel patched here, channels two to four tune the other three resonators unless they have cables of their own
One volt per octave added to its own resonator's FREQ knob, taking that resonator off any polyphonic cable in the first pitch jack
Divided by 10, scaled by its attenuverter and added to the DECAY knob; each channel of a polyphonic cable reaches the resonator of the same number, and the last channel covers any left over
Divided by 10, scaled by its attenuverter and added to the COLOR knob; each channel of a polyphonic cable reaches the resonator of the same number, and the last channel covers any left over
Divided by 10, scaled by its attenuverter and added to the GAIN knobs; each channel of a polyphonic cable reaches the resonator of the same number, and the last channel covers any left over
Divided by 10, scaled by its attenuverter and added to the MIX knob; only the first channel is read

outputs.text: The input and the summed resonators crossfaded by MIX, the resonators first scaled by AMP
The four resonators on four channels, each at its own GAIN setting, with no AMP scaling and no dry signal mixed in

notes: the pitch of each resonator, knob and jack together, is clamped to four and a half octaves either side of C4
with the module bypassed the audio input is passed straight to the OUT jack
